source_evidence: You may cancel your contract within a short period (usually 10 to 30 days) of receiving it without a penalty fee called a surrender charge.
answer: A variable annuity’s free look period is a short window—usually 10 to 30 days after you receive the contract—when you can cancel without a surrender charge. You will typically receive a refund of your purchase payments, but the refund may be adjusted up or down based on how your investment options performed. Check your contract for the exact deadline and instructions for returning it.
